extension.summary: Synchronised Plex playback with friends in PM4K
extension.description: Watch Party synchronises Plex playback in PM4K across devices, so friends in different places can watch together. Start a watch party and invite people: playback starts, pauses and skips for everyone at the same time. Requires a Watch Party server and a connection code from its administrator.
extension.news: v0.3.10 - After a skip, a device that lands precisely (a computer) lines up once more if it ended up a little off from the others. Devices that land less precisely, like most TVs, are left as they are. - Works together with devices that have not updated yet: checked before every release. - A setting changed in the menu just as Watch Party connects (such as Do not disturb) is no longer missed. v0.3.9 - After Watch Party is used, the device stays online for a while (the administrator sets how long), then goes quiet until it is opened again. In standby it is quiet too. - Accepting an invitation in the menu after standby no longer leaves the watch party right away; a watch party left in standby is left properly once Kodi wakes. - A play, pause or skip is never sent twice when the connection hiccups. - Inviting someone who is not online says the invitation waits in their Watch Party menu. - On Windows, settings are no longer lost when a file is briefly in use. - A device not using Watch Party lately does not announce updates.

extension.description: Install this once. Kodi then keeps Watch Party up to date by itself.
